results.title: Drill from a section into a place, a person's oikos and generations
results.checks: On Acts 16 tap the heading 'Lydia’s Conversion in Philippi' → Setting: the map draws Philippi; Cast → Lydia opens her card; Back; open Paul from 'Paul’s Vision of the Macedonian' → Cast: his Oikos draws rings (Barnabas, Silas among those he walked with) and Generations draws the churches he planted, Church at Philippi among them, and Epaphras's Church at Colossae a generation further
results.note: Philippi on the map; Lydia's card; Paul's oikos (Barnabas, Silas) and generations (What grew out of Paul: 2 generations)
